hook: The 'Mineral Candy' That Supports Healthy Teeth And Gums
claim: PowerBite is a dental 'mineral candy': a tablet you let dissolve in your mouth at night, like a cough drop, to support teeth and gums.
ing_note: Amounts aren't disclosed. PowerBite doesn't contain fluoride or hydroxyapatite.
use: Let one candy dissolve in your mouth at night before sleep.
price_note: PowerBite is sold as 1, 3 or 6 bottles with free shipping on every order; totals appear on the order page.
refund_note: The money-back guarantee starts from when your order arrives.
bonuses: Total Body Detox After Tooth & Gum Decay
checks: Xylitol is the best-supported ingredient: frequent xylitol gum or mints can reduce cavity-causing bacteria, usually at 5–10 g a day spread through the day.
One candy a night is unlikely to deliver that much xylitol.
Calcium carbonate doesn't rebuild enamel; fluoride and hydroxyapatite do the most for early decay.
Dissolving a tablet after brushing at night leaves residue on teeth, so check the label for sugar.
cons: Can't reverse decay or gum disease
verdict: PowerBite is a pleasant mint with some sensible ingredients, but it can't fix decay or gum disease. Brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste, clean between teeth and see a dentist regularly. If you like the idea, plain xylitol gum after meals is a cheaper, better-studied option.
